property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.service.name
property.description: Ranger service name for Trino. Must match the service created in Ranger Admin UI.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.policy.rest.url
property.description: Ranger Admin URL for policy retrieval.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.policy.pollIntervalMs
property.description: Interval (ms) for Ranger plugin to poll Admin for policy updates. Dev setting; use 30000 in production.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.use.rangerGroups
property.description: Use Ranger groups for RBAC. Groups are synced from LDAP/AD via Ranger usersync.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.access.cluster.name
property.description: Logical cluster name for audit trail identification.

property.name: ranger.plugin.trino.policy.cache.dir
property.description: Directory for local policy cache (fallback when Ranger Admin is unreachable).
